name: design-review
description: Expert design and UX review of rendered web apps, websites, app UI flows, infographics and design artifacts — the last pass before a human looks at AI-built UI. Deterministic accessibility, contrast, target-size, performance and motion gates first; then structural, state, craft, flow and design-system passes against real renders at multiple viewports; then severity-ranked findings with pasteable fixes, evidence, and an explicit statement of what was never checked.
